topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The kid swears it's all his own work, eyes wide as the innocence he claims. I've seen this game before. Ain't no one this clean in a city where the rain washes away more than just the grime. I've got his professor on the line, and she's got the proof—chyron stats, quoted sections, the works. The kid's stuttering, defenses tangled like a cheap payphone cord. I'm supposed to believe he’s just the latest in a long line of untouchable geniuses? No, this town's got its way of wearing down the truth, and I plan to find out where his lies begin and end.
